description: The Women's Club Water Polo Team commits to ensuring all interested students an opportunity to be a part of a team, meet new friends, develop new skills, challenge one's self, have fun, and play competitive water polo.

name: Women's Ice Hockey
description: To provide an opportunity for women at the University of Michigan to play intercollegiate ice hockey at a competitive level.

name: Women's Michigan Hockey League
description: This is a women's ice hockey league that is a welcoming environment for the women of UMich to enjoy quality stick and puck time! We are an intramural league that promotes the continuation or beginning of hockey careers of the Victors.

name: Women+ Excelling More in Math, Engineering, and the Sciences
description: F.E.M.M.E.S. is a student-led organization which hosts educational outreach programs related to science, technology, engineering and math (STEM) for 4th-12th grade students from underserved areas.

name: Women+ in Robotics and Engineering
description: Women+ in Robotics and Engineering (WiRE+) connects graduate students at U-M who are pursuing robotics and engineering. Our programs are designed for women in robotics but are open to all.

name: Wood Carving Club at UMich
description: The Wood Carving Club at UMich welcomes all skill levels to learn, create, and connect through woodworking. Members develop carving techniques, creativity, and manual dexterity in a fun and inclusive environment while enjoying hands-on projects

name: WORTH
description: WORTH is an organization for the discussion of women's health issues as they appear in our campus environment as well as worldwide. The organization approaches these issues through smaller focus groups striving to enact change locally and globally.

name: Writer to Writer
description: A literary journal produced by University of Michigan Sweetland Minor in Writing students.

name: Writers' Den
description: Writers' Community is a student-led creative writing group founded in 2008, with a focus around group workshop and writing activities.

name: Wuh Luh Wuh Social Club
description: This organization exists to cultivate connections among the WLW (Women Loving Women) student community at the University of Michigan. We do so by gathering to play board games and do other activities together.

name: Xi Chapter of The Zeta Psi Fraternity
description: Zeta Psi strives to be the premier international men's fraternal organization dedicated to promoting academic excellence, forging life-long bonds of brotherhood, and developing the leaders and innovators of the future.

name: Yemeni Students' Association
description: The Yemeni Students' Association promotes and motivates awareness of Yemeni existence and culture on campus.

name: Young Americans for Freedom
description: YAF is a non-profit, non-partisan organization that brings students together to advocate for the ideas of limited government, individual freedom, free enterprise, and a strong national defense.

name: Young Democratic Socialists of America at the University of Michigan
description: We are this university's DSA (Democratic Socialists of America) chapter. Our mission is to educate and organize students and young people in unique positions as students to play a principled role in the movement for social and economic justice.

name: Youth and Democracy in the Americas at the University of Michigan - Ann Arbor
description: Youth and Democracy in the Americas empowers the next generation of leaders to defend freedom, strengthen democracy, and uphold the rule of law across the Western Hemisphere.

name: Yuru Band
description: Yuru Band (formerly Ontaku) is a student-run music band that loves watching anime and playing music. Our ensemble performs Japanese and anime-related pieces at various events held on campus each semester. Musicians of all skill levels are welcome!

name: Zero Waste Club
description: Zero Waste Club aims to create a more sustainable campus by helping our community learn about and practice zero waste and circular systems in fun, accessible, and impactful ways. We welcome all students regardless of their knowledge of zero waste.

name: Zeta Omega Eta
description: Zeta Omega Eta is a non-traditional and intersectional sorority that aims to bring strong, passionate people together to redefine what it means to be a feminist and sorority member.

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. Gamma Delta Chapter
description: As one of nine historically Black fraternities and sororities, Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. is “a community conscious, action-oriented organization,” striving to uphold and exemplify the ideals of scholarship, service, sisterly love, and Finer Womanhood.

name: Zeta Pi Professional Technology Fraternity
description: Co-ed Professional Technology Fraternity established in 2023 at the University of Michigan.

name: Zouk Dance Club
description: A dance club intended for everyone interested in Brazilian Zouk dance, body rolls, and excessive hair whips. We meet weekly for beginner classes, socials, informal practicas and workshops lead by internationally acclaimed Zouk instructors.
